msg: a1 R1 findings (kernel v7.2 source + TAS2781 datasheet SLOSE86B + live sysfs): (1) Amps are a minor part: datasheet idle per amp = AVDD 15.5mA@1.8V + PVDDL 2.2mA@3.8V + PVDDH 0.04-3mA => ~37-65 mW each, ~0.08-0.15 W for two incl. regulators; SW shutdown ~20 uW. Remaining >=0.5 W is SoC side. Live: /proc/asound/card0/pcm0p/sub0/status = RUNNING for ~32 min (hw_ptr advancing), 0000:00:1f.3 runtime active, low_power_idle_cpu_residency_us = 0 (PC10 never reached since boot) - check whether sink really pauses when idle. (2) Bug still in v7.2 and master (no fix commit through f6635d6/431c156, Aug 2026): tasdevice_tuning_switch(0) -> tasdevice_select_tuningprm_cfg only calls tasdev_load_calibrated_data when tasdevice[i].cur_conf != cfg_no. 'Speaker Config Id' put (tasdevice_config_put) only stores priv->cur_conf, writes NO hardware; toggling 1 then 0 with no OPEN in between is a no-op by code. All kcontrols are consumed only inside the OPEN hook => action must be BEFORE open. Guaranteed path: 'Speaker Force Firmware Load'=on (numid=3): every OPEN sets cur_conf=-1, reloads program+conf+calibration; cost reported on linux-sound (Yoga Pro 9 16IMH9, 2026-06-07) is 2-3 s start delay. (3) No kcontrol powers amps down with PCM open; driver holds pm_runtime ref OPEN..CLOSE; runtime_resume only tasdevice_prmg_load (no calib). udev power/control=on keeps amps ACTIVE from boot until first close (runtime_suspend is the only thing shutting down the load-time power-up). (4) Recommend: drop keep-open, set Force Firmware Load once per boot (static, no watcher, race-free since reload runs inside open()); WP hook / pactl watcher fire after OPEN = too late. Verify with dyndbg: must not see 'Unneeded loading dsp conf' on reopen.
